study: N2 part 2: the historical AttackNetV2.2 combined checkpoint on the 3,000 NUAA test frames of N1, two image-preparation variants fixed before the test (whole image; face crop), no retraining

model.source: shared by the coordinator (Google Drive file of 7 July 2026), downloaded on 29 October 2026; training data per the historical code: combined_all = 3DMAD, CSMAD, Replay-Attack, MSSpoof, Our Dataset (no NUAA)
model.loading: tf.keras.models.load_model(path, compile=False) on the CPU (GPU hidden), no custom objects, SHA-256 verified before loading
model.score: softmax output, column 1 (attack probability), as in the historical evaluation code (argmax = attack if column 1 > 0.5)

whole_image.description: the whole original frame, as create_datasets.py processes the files it receives
whole_image.chain: cv2.imread (BGR) -> BGR to RGB -> cv2.resize 256x256 INTER_LANCZOS4 -> advanced_image_enhancement (reference create_datasets.py) -> uint8 -> float32 / 255 -> (x - 0.5) * 2 (reference dataset_loader.py, normalize=True)

face_crop.description: the face region found by the current application detector, then the same chain
face_crop.crop: Face.crop(margin=0.15, square=True) of the detected box (RetinaFace via OpenCV DNN, Haar cascade when RetinaFace finds nothing)
face_crop.fallback: the whole frame when no face is found (recorded per frame; no frame excluded)
face_crop.chain: cv2.imread (BGR) -> detector -> crop -> BGR to RGB -> cv2.resize 256x256 INTER_LANCZOS4 -> advanced_image_enhancement -> uint8 -> float32 / 255 -> (x - 0.5) * 2

quality_filter: none: every one of the 3,000 frames is scored (the historical quality filter 0.65 is not applied; declared)

metrics.threshold_origin: fixed before the test, as in the historical argmax rule and in N1; not calibrated on the historical source validation (not available here) nor on this test; no score inversion
metrics.comparison: one row per variant next to the three N1 LivenessNet rows (study 20261024-N1-LivenessNet-fb93496, aggregate.json), same 3,000 frames, same threshold; the comparison changes architecture, training recipe and training data at once
metrics.distributions: score_attack histogram per class, 10 bins of width 0.1 on [0, 1], per variant
metrics.public: aggregate.json, aggregate.md, figure_distributions.png: no identifiers, no per-image rows

data.originals: every file located by key under the images folder, SHA-256 and size equal to the manifest row before use
